fusions.name: Lingering Cloud
fusions.desc: A cloud settles over every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage and gnawing at each for 1 damage a second for 12 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Strip to the Stalk
fusions.desc: Sends a bite at the first enemy it meets, using up one of your afflictions on it to deal 8 damage. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Settling Plague
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a swarm for 15 seconds that bites an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every 1.5 seconds. Each bite has a 30% chance to leave the target [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gorge by Degrees
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once and you are healed for 4% of your maximum health per stack (24% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
